promise: NEW YORKERS is sold in named releases. Each release is sized and closed before it opens. Nothing is added to a release once it closes, and no New Yorker is ever sold twice. The census is still being painted, so more releases will follow, and every one is announced in advance, the same way.
promiseShort: Sold in named releases. Each one closed before it opens, and no New Yorker sold twice.
expansion: This is an evolving series. New eras are still being painted, and the city keeps nominating people who are not in it yet. When a release is announced it says exactly what is in it, how many, in what format, on what platform and when. Nothing is ever quietly added to something you already bought into.
note: THE ONES chapter one opens Thursday September 10, 11:11 AM ET. THE CENSUS RELEASE mints Tuesday October 6, 11:11 AM ET. Dates and prices below are the artist's published intent and are not final until each release opens.

releases.name: THE MARKS
releases.drawnFrom: Every painted number divisible by one hundred, plus the closing number of every era. Era I is not included.
releases.subseries: The hundred marks and the era closers
releases.when: Waves run from late September. Dates announced one at a time.
releases.detail: Eighteen era closers go to SuperRare as a monthly series. Seventy two hundred marks go to Transient Labs in six waves. Every era painted after this one adds six more marks, and those belong to a later release, never to this one.
releases.price: Hundred marks $345 flat. Era closers by auction with a published reserve.

releases.name: THE ONES
releases.drawnFrom: Chosen by hand from 6,399 eligible pieces, in fifteen chapters of ten. Era I, Era XVIII, the hundred marks and the era closers are all excluded, and so is every piece already inside THE MARKS.
releases.when: Chapter one opens Thursday September 10. One chapter a month from then on, through and past the census release.
releases.detail: The only release in this collection selected by judgement rather than by an arithmetic rule, and the method is published with it. Chapters run on their own monthly clock and do not gate any other release. Each chapter is a hang that stands on its own. Borough floors are held on purpose: twelve Staten Island, fifteen Bronx, nineteen Queens, thirty eight Brooklyn. Nothing in this release is ever reopened or topped up, and no piece in it appears in the census release. The price ladder for every chapter is published in advance and never moves.
releases.price: Chapter one 0.05 ETH. Chapter two 0.08. Chapter three 0.11. The ladder rises and is published before any chapter opens.

releases.name: THE CENSUS RELEASE
releases.drawnFrom: Drawn across eras II to XIX so no era is emptied, with every family, every borough and every set represented, and excluding the hundred and fifty in THE ONES.
releases.format: Dynamic tokens on ERC-7160. The artist appends states, the collector pins the one that shows.
releases.detail: Era I is excluded because it paints real public figures. Pieces promised back to the people who nominated them are excluded, and so is every piece in THE ONES. Nothing in this release is ever reopened or topped up.
releases.price: $11 flat. Four windows on mint day. Eleven per wallet in the open window.

future.headline: More will follow
future.body: The census is not finished and was never meant to be. Eras are still being painted, nominations arrive every week, and one is chosen every Sunday. Work that is not in a named release is not for sale yet, and it is not being held back forever either. It is simply not its turn.
